encounter.title: Prologue 2 — Mistake Has a Cost (5x5 Candidate B, seed 20)
encounter.notes: LD-005 Prologue 5x5 Candidate B. Board: square5 (5x5), seed 20, 6 arrows (N1 E2 S0 W3). 2 E arrows: #0 is free; #1 is blocked by #2(W). Clean path: #0(E) -> #2(W) -> #1(E) kills with 0 damage. Tapping #1 while blocked costs 1 HP.
